purpose: Define candidate→semantic diff→validation→authorization→accepted revision→activation lifecycle for privacy, retention, consent, purpose and classification policies.

topics.name: Governance Policy Change Boundary
topics.purpose: Define candidate→semantic diff→validation→authorization→accepted revision→activation lifecycle for privacy, retention, consent, purpose and classification policies.

semantics.candidate_rule: Policy edits create inert candidate revisions.
semantics.base_rule: Candidate references exact accepted base revision.
semantics.diff_rule: Semantic impact diff identifies changed data/purpose/retention/disclosure scopes.
semantics.validation_rule: Cross-policy conflicts/invalid gaps are validated before apply.
semantics.authorization_rule: Governance policy administration requires explicit authority.
semantics.activation_rule: Accepted policy revision and active evaluator snapshot remain distinct.
semantics.failure_rule: Activation failure never disables governance silently.
semantics.audit_rule: Policy changes create exact audit evidence.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: editing UI changes live privacy policy instantly

references.purpose: Governance policy changes are audited exactly.
